title: Evidence module
acceptance: service(ctx) exports addDocument, listDocuments, getDocument, readContent, extract, reviewExtraction, getAcceptedFacts per modules.md#evidence
routes under /claims/{claimId}/documents* match openapi including x-roles; accept base64 JSON and multipart (hand-parsed from req.rawBody); node --test tests/unit/evidence/routes.test.mjs passes
bytes stored AES-GCM encrypted with ctx.crypto per tenant at data/blobs/<tenant>/<claim>/<docId> next to dbPath; test asserts file on disk is not plaintext and readContent round-trips

claim.evidence.added triggers extraction via ctx.ai.run (fake in tests); field results carry confidence and provenance; claim.evidence.extracted published without PII; .txt and simple PDF text extraction work, unreadable PDF sets needs_review; photo sidecar metadata handled
kind auto-detect when missing; reviewExtraction updates accepted/value; getAcceptedFacts returns accepted or high-confidence facts only
brief:
Implement per modules.md#evidence; read core-runtime-api.md for store, bus (publish/subscribe, outbox), crypto (tenant-bound ctx addendum), audit and router APIs. Tables documents and extractions as listed. Upload route: Content-Type application/json {kind?,filename,contentType,contentBase64,metadata?} or multipart/form-data with file part and optional kind/metadata parts; write minimal boundary parser (split on boundary, parse part headers, binary-safe on Buffer). Validate size limit (e.g. 10 MB) and allowed content types. Subscribe to claim.evidence.added and run extract async so upload returns fast; extract is idempotent unless force. Text: .txt decode utf8; PDF: scan for uncompressed text objects (BT ... (text) Tj / TJ ... ET) best-effort, if none mark extraction needs_review. Photos: optional JSON sidecar passed as metadata (damageAreas, make, model, color); without it low confidence. Auto-detect kind from filename/content keywords (police report, estimate, invoice) else other. getAcceptedFacts maps field name to {value,confidence,provenance} for fields with status accepted or confidence >= 0.8 and not rejected. readContent must be audited as sensitive read (ctx.audit). Never log bytes or extracted PII. In tests inject a fake ctx.ai whose run returns the shapes below, fake store/bus per existing tests in tests/unit for patterns. Do not depend on S1-AI-01/02 files.
SHARED AI TASK I/O SHAPES (all teams code against these; local provider must emit them exactly): ai.run returns {output,provider,model,confidence,explanation,usage,unconfirmed?}. Provider interface (src/ai/providers/<name>.mjs default export factory (ctx,opts)=>{name, available():Promise<boolean>, run(task,input,{tier,schema}):Promise<{output,confidence,explanation,usage,model}|{refusal:true}>}). Outputs: extract_narrative in {text} out {lossType,lossDate,location,injuries:boolean,injuryCues[],atFault:'insured'|'other'|'unknown',cues[]}; extract_document in {kind?,text,filename} out {kind,fields:[{name,value,confidence,provenance:{snippet}}],needsReview}; classify_photo in {filename,metadata?} out {kind:'photo',damageAreas[],vehicle:{make,model,color},fields:[same as above],needsReview}; severity in {facts} out {score 0-100,band,drivers[]}; fraud_signals in {facts} out {score,indicators:[{code,weight,reason}]}; subrogation in {facts} out {flag,reasons[],confidence}; summarize in {facts} out {summary,bullets[]}; next_best_actions in {facts} out {actions:[{code,label,reason,priority}]}. Field names for extracted document facts: policeReportNumber, citedParty, atFaultParty, estimateTotal, repairShop, lossDate, vin, damageAreas.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; 16 evidence tests pass (service+routes); encrypted blobs, event without PII, routes/x-roles match openapi, tenant isolation tested
